// Search functionality using Nominatim geocoding
var searchTimeout = null;
var currentSearchQuery = '';

function initializeSearch() {
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
  const searchResults = document.getElementById('searchResults');
  const searchClear = document.getElementById('searchClear');

  if (!searchInput || !searchResults || !searchClear) return;

  // Handle input changes with debouncing
  searchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
    const query = this.value.trim();

    // Show/hide clear button
    if (query.length > 0) {
      searchClear.classList.add('active');
    } else {
      searchClear.classList.remove('active');
      searchResults.classList.remove('active');
      searchResults.innerHTML = '';
    }

    // Debounce search
    clearTimeout(searchTimeout);
    if (query.length >= 2) {
      searchTimeout = setTimeout(() => performSearch(query), 300);
    }
  });

  // Handle clear button
  searchClear.addEventListener('click', function() {
    searchInput.value = '';
    searchClear.classList.remove('active');
    searchResults.classList.remove('active');
    searchResults.innerHTML = '';
    currentSearchQuery = '';
  });

  // Handle Enter key
  searchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      e.preventDefault();
      const query = this.value.trim();
      if (query.length >= 2) {
        performSearch(query, true);
      }
    }
  });

  // Close results when clicking outside
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !searchResults.contains(e.target)) {
      searchResults.classList.remove('active');
    }
  });
}

async function performSearch(query, selectFirst = false) {
  const searchResults = document.getElementById('searchResults');
  if (!searchResults) return;

  try {
    // Use Nominatim API for geocoding
    const url = `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?` +
      `format=json&q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=5&addressdetails=1`;

    const response = await fetch(url, {
      headers: {
        'User-Agent': 'Safecast Map (https://map.safecast.org)'
      }
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Search failed');
    }

    const results = await response.json();

    if (results.length === 0) {
      searchResults.innerHTML = '<div class="search-result-item">No results found</div>';
      searchResults.classList.add('active');
      return;
    }

    // If selectFirst is true (Enter key pressed), go to first result
    if (selectFirst && results.length > 0) {
      selectSearchResult(results[0], query);
      return;
    }

    // Display results
    searchResults.innerHTML = results.map(result => {
      const name = result.display_name.split(',')[0];
      const details = result.display_name.split(',').slice(1).join(',').trim();
      return `
        <div class="search-result-item" data-lat="${result.lat}" data-lon="${result.lon}" data-name="${escapeHtml(result.display_name)}">
          <div class="search-result-name">${escapeHtml(name)}</div>
          <div class="search-result-details">${escapeHtml(details)}</div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');

    // Add click handlers to results
    searchResults.querySelectorAll('.search-result-item').forEach((item, index) => {
      item.addEventListener('click', () => {
        selectSearchResult(results[index], query);
      });
    });

    searchResults.classList.add('active');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Search error:', error);
    searchResults.innerHTML = '<div class="search-result-item">Search error. Please try again.</div>';
    searchResults.classList.add('active');
  }
}

function selectSearchResult(result, query) {
  const searchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
  const searchResults = document.getElementById('searchResults');
  const searchClear = document.getElementById('searchClear');

  // Store the search query
  currentSearchQuery = query;

  // Hide results
  if (searchResults) {
    searchResults.classList.remove('active');
  }

  // Update input
  if (searchInput) {
    searchInput.value = result.display_name.split(',')[0];
  }

  // Pan to location with appropriate zoom
  const lat = parseFloat(result.lat);
  const lon = parseFloat(result.lon);

  // Debug: log what we received to help identify classification issues
  console.log('Search result:', {
    name: result.display_name,
    type: result.type,
    class: result.class,
    addresstype: result.addresstype,
    place_rank: result.place_rank
  });

  // Determine zoom level based on result type and class
  // Use place_rank from Nominatim: 1-3=country, 4-11=state/region, 12-16=city, 17-18=town, 19-20=village
  let zoom = 15; // Default for cities - closer street-level view

  // Only treat as country if explicitly marked as country (place_rank 1-3)
  if (result.type === 'country' || result.addresstype === 'country' ||
      (result.class === 'boundary' && result.type === 'administrative' && result.place_rank <= 3)) {
    zoom = 6;
  }
  // Handle states, provinces, regions (place_rank 4-11)
  else if (result.type === 'state' || result.type === 'province' || result.type === 'region' ||
           (result.class === 'boundary' && result.type === 'administrative' && result.place_rank >= 4 && result.place_rank <= 11)) {
    zoom = 9;
  }
  // Handle cities - place_rank 12-16 or explicit city type
  else if (result.type === 'city' ||
           (result.class === 'boundary' && result.type === 'administrative' && result.place_rank >= 12 && result.place_rank <= 16) ||
           (result.class === 'place' && result.addresstype === 'city')) {
    zoom = 15;
  }
  // Handle towns, villages, hamlets, suburbs - zoom in close for small towns (place_rank 17+)
  else if (result.type === 'town' || result.type === 'village' || result.type === 'hamlet' ||
           result.type === 'suburb' || result.type === 'neighbourhood' || result.type === 'quarter' ||
           (result.class === 'place') || (result.place_rank >= 17)) {
    zoom = 16;
  }
  // Handle specific addresses and points of interest
  else if (result.type === 'house' || result.type === 'building' || result.class === 'amenity') {
    zoom = 17;
  }

  map.setView([lat, lon], zoom);
  saveMapViewState();

  // Update URL will be called by the map's moveend event
}

function centerMapToLocation() {
  if (navigator.geolocation) {
    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
      function(position) {
        var userLat = position.coords.latitude;
        var userLon = position.coords.longitude;

        setStoredUserCenter(userLat, userLon);
        map.setView([userLat, userLon], Math.max(12, defaultCfg.zoom));
        saveMapViewState();

        L.marker([userLat, userLon]).addTo(map)
          .bindPopup(translate("your_location")).openPopup();
      },
      async function(error) {
        switch(error.code) {
          case error.PERMISSION_DENIED:
            alert(translate("location_permission_denied"));
            break;
          case error.POSITION_UNAVAILABLE:
            alert(translate("location_unavailable"));
            break;
          case error.TIMEOUT:
            alert(translate("location_timeout"));
            break;
          default:
            alert(translate("location_error"));
            break;
        }
        const ipGuess = await requestGeoIPFallback();
        if (ipGuess) {
          setStoredUserCenter(ipGuess.lat, ipGuess.lon);
          map.setView([ipGuess.lat, ipGuess.lon], Math.max(12, defaultCfg.zoom));
          saveMapViewState();
        }
      }
    );
  } else {
    alert(translate("geolocation_not_supported"));
    requestGeoIPFallback().then(guess => {
      if (guess) {
        setStoredUserCenter(guess.lat, guess.lon);
        map.setView([guess.lat, guess.lon], Math.max(12, defaultCfg.zoom));
        saveMapViewState();
      }
    });
  }
}

// ===== HOME OVERLAY FUNCTIONALITY =====
// Tracks whether markers should be loaded (false until user selects location)
var homeOverlayDismissed = false;

function shouldShowHomeOverlay() {
  // Don't show home overlay if:
  // 1. We're in track view mode
  // 2. URL has location parameters (user came with specific location)
  // 3. User has previously dismissed the overlay this session
  // 4. There's a saved map view state
  
  if (isTrackView) return false;
  
  const params = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
  const hasLocationParams = params.has('minLat') || params.has('place') || params.has('lat');
  if (hasLocationParams) return false;
  
  if (sessionStorage.getItem('homeOverlayDismissed')) return false;
  
  if (loadMapViewState()) return false;
  
  return true;
}

function dismissHomeOverlay() {
  const overlay = document.getElementById('homeOverlay');
  if (overlay) {
    overlay.classList.add('hidden');
  }
  homeOverlayDismissed = true;
  sessionStorage.setItem('homeOverlayDismissed', 'true');
  
  // Now that the overlay is dismissed, load markers
  if (typeof debounceUpdateMarkers === 'function') {
    debounceUpdateMarkers();
  }
}

function initializeHomeOverlay() {
  const homeOverlay = document.getElementById('homeOverlay');
  const homeSearchInput = document.getElementById('homeSearchInput');
  const homeSearchResults = document.getElementById('homeSearchResults');
  const homeLocateBtn = document.getElementById('homeLocateBtn');
  const homeSkipLink = document.getElementById('homeSkipLink');
  
  if (!homeOverlay) return;
  
  // Overlay starts hidden in HTML; only reveal when appropriate
  if (!shouldShowHomeOverlay()) {
    homeOverlayDismissed = true;
    return;
  }
  homeOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
  
  // Home search functionality
  let homeSearchTimeout = null;
  
  if (homeSearchInput) {
    homeSearchInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
      const query = this.value.trim();
      
      clearTimeout(homeSearchTimeout);
      if (query.length >= 2) {
        homeSearchTimeout = setTimeout(() => performHomeSearch(query), 300);
      } else {
        homeSearchResults.classList.remove('active');
        homeSearchResults.innerHTML = '';
      }
    });
    
    homeSearchInput.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        const query = this.value.trim();
        if (query.length >= 2) {
          performHomeSearch(query, true);
        }
      }
    });
    
    // Focus the search input when overlay shows
    setTimeout(() => homeSearchInput.focus(), 100);
  }
  
  // Use my location button
  if (homeLocateBtn) {
    homeLocateBtn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      dismissHomeOverlay();
      // Small delay to let the overlay fade, then locate
      setTimeout(() => centerMapToLocation(), 100);
    });
  }
  
  // Skip link - explore globally
  if (homeSkipLink) {
    homeSkipLink.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.preventDefault();
      dismissHomeOverlay();
    });
  }
  
  // Close results when clicking outside
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (homeSearchResults && !homeSearchInput.contains(e.target) && !homeSearchResults.contains(e.target)) {
      homeSearchResults.classList.remove('active');
    }
  });
}

async function performHomeSearch(query, selectFirst = false) {
  const homeSearchResults = document.getElementById('homeSearchResults');
  if (!homeSearchResults) return;

  try {
    const url = `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?` +
      `format=json&q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=5&addressdetails=1`;

    const response = await fetch(url, {
      headers: {
        'User-Agent': 'Safecast Map (https://map.safecast.org)'
      }
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error('Search failed');
    }

    const results = await response.json();

    if (results.length === 0) {
      homeSearchResults.innerHTML = '<div class="home-search-result-item">' + translate('no_results_found') + '</div>';
      homeSearchResults.classList.add('active');
      return;
    }

    if (selectFirst && results.length > 0) {
      selectHomeSearchResult(results[0], query);
      return;
    }

    homeSearchResults.innerHTML = results.map(result => {
      const name = result.display_name.split(',')[0];
      const details = result.display_name.split(',').slice(1).join(',').trim();
      return `
        <div class="home-search-result-item" data-lat="${result.lat}" data-lon="${result.lon}">
          <div class="home-search-result-name">${escapeHtml(name)}</div>
          <div class="home-search-result-details">${escapeHtml(details)}</div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');

    homeSearchResults.querySelectorAll('.home-search-result-item').forEach((item, index) => {
      item.addEventListener('click', () => {
        selectHomeSearchResult(results[index], query);
      });
    });

    homeSearchResults.classList.add('active');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Home search error:', error);
    homeSearchResults.innerHTML = '<div class="home-search-result-item">' + translate('search_error') + '</div>';
    homeSearchResults.classList.add('active');
  }
}

function selectHomeSearchResult(result, query) {
  // Store the search query for URL
  currentSearchQuery = query;
  
  // Dismiss the overlay first
  dismissHomeOverlay();
  
  // Update the main search input
  const mainSearchInput = document.getElementById('searchInput');
  if (mainSearchInput) {
    mainSearchInput.value = result.display_name.split(',')[0];
  }
  
  // Navigate to location with appropriate zoom
  const lat = parseFloat(result.lat);
  const lon = parseFloat(result.lon);
  
  // Determine zoom level based on result type
  let zoom = 15;
  if (result.type === 'country' || result.addresstype === 'country' ||
      (result.class === 'boundary' && result.type === 'administrative' && result.place_rank <= 3)) {
    zoom = 6;
  } else if (result.type === 'state' || result.type === 'province' || result.type === 'region' ||
             (result.class === 'boundary' && result.type === 'administrative' && result.place_rank >= 4 && result.place_rank <= 11)) {
    zoom = 9;
  } else if (result.type === 'city' ||
             (result.class === 'boundary' && result.type === 'administrative' && result.place_rank >= 12 && result.place_rank <= 16) ||
             (result.class === 'place' && result.addresstype === 'city')) {

             result.type === 'suburb' || result.type === 'neighbourhood' || result.type === 'quarter' ||
             (result.class === 'place') || (result.place_rank >= 17)) {
    zoom = 16;

    zoom = 17;
  }

  map.setView([lat, lon], zoom);

    <script>
      let backgroundRefreshTimer = null;
      function startBackgroundImportRefresh() {
        if (backgroundRefreshTimer) {
          clearInterval(backgroundRefreshTimer);
        }
        let rounds = 0;
        backgroundRefreshTimer = setInterval(() => {
          // Set flag to disable parallel tile loading during background refresh
          window.isBackgroundRefresh = true;
          updateMarkers();
          window.isBackgroundRefresh = false;
          rounds += 1;
          if (rounds >= 24) {
            clearInterval(backgroundRefreshTimer);
            backgroundRefreshTimer = null;
          }
        }, 5000);
      }

      function uploadFiles() {
        const fileInput  = document.getElementById('fileInput');
        const files      = fileInput.files;
        if (!files.length) {
          alert(translate('select_files'));
          return;
        }

        const fileOverlay          = document.getElementById('fileOverlay');
        const fileProgressContainer = document.getElementById('fileProgressContainer');
        fileProgressContainer.innerHTML = '';
        fileOverlay.style.display  = 'flex';

        /* counter and URL of last track */
        let completedUploads = 0;
        const totalFiles     = files.length;
        let lastTrackURL     = null;

        /* Create an XHR for each file but redirect only once */
        [...files].forEach(file => {
          /* --- visual progress elements --- */
          const fileBlock        = document.createElement('div');
          fileBlock.className    = 'file-progress';
          const fileName         = document.createElement('div');
          fileName.className     = 'file-name';
          fileName.innerText     = file.name;
          const progressBar      = document.createElement('div');
          progressBar.className  = 'progress-bar';
          const progressBarInner = document.createElement('div');
          progressBarInner.className = 'progress-bar-inner';
          progressBar.appendChild(progressBarInner);
          const serverProcessing = document.createElement('div');
          serverProcessing.className = 'server-processing';
          serverProcessing.innerText = translate('waiting_for_server');
          fileBlock.append(fileName, progressBar, serverProcessing);
          fileProgressContainer.appendChild(fileBlock);
          /* ------------------------------------------------- */

          const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
          xhr.open('POST', '/upload', true);
          xhr.withCredentials = true; // Ensure session cookies are sent

          let eventSource = null;
          let trackID = null;
          let sseStarted = false;

          /* file upload progress (uploading to server) */
          xhr.upload.onprogress = e => {
            if (e.lengthComputable) {
              const percent = (e.loaded / e.total) * 100;
              progressBarInner.style.width = percent + '%';
              
              // When upload completes (100%), show processing state
              if (percent >= 100) {
                progressBarInner.classList.add('processing');
                serverProcessing.innerText = translate('processing_on_server') + ' ...';
                serverProcessing.style.color = '#ff9800';
              }
            }
          };

          /* handle server response - now returns immediately with trackID */
          xhr.onload = () => {
            if (xhr.status === 200) {
              const response = JSON.parse(xhr.responseText);
              
              // Server returns trackID immediately, processing happens in background
              if (response.status === 'processing' && response.trackID) {
                trackID = response.trackID;
                sseStarted = true;
                serverProcessing.innerText = translate('processing_on_server') + ' 0%';
                
                // Start SSE connection for real-time progress
                eventSource = new EventSource('/upload/progress?trackid=' + trackID);
                eventSource.onmessage = (event) => {
                  try {
                    const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                    const pct = Math.round(data.percent);
                    serverProcessing.innerText = translate('processing_on_server') + ' ' + pct + '%';
                    
                    // Check if processing is complete
                    if (data.complete) {
                      eventSource.close();
                      progressBarInner.classList.remove('processing');
                      
                      if (data.error) {
                        serverProcessing.innerText = '✘ Error: ' + data.error;
                        serverProcessing.style.color = 'red';
                      } else if (data.needsCoordinates && data.trackID) {
                        // Spectrum file needs location
                        serverProcessing.innerText = '⚠ Needs location';
                        serverProcessing.style.color = 'orange';
                        pendingCoordinateUpdate = { 
                          trackID: data.trackID, 
                          fileName: data.fileName || file.name, 
                          trackURL: data.redirectURL 
                        };
                      } else {
                        serverProcessing.innerText = translate('processing_on_server') + ' 100%';
                        serverProcessing.style.color = '#4caf50';
                        
                        if (data.redirectURL) {
                          lastTrackURL = data.redirectURL;
                        }
                      }
                      
                      // Trigger completion handler
                      completedUploads++;
                      if (completedUploads === totalFiles) {
                        setTimeout(() => {
                          fileOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                          if (pendingCoordinateUpdate) {
                            showCoordinateDialog(pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackID, pendingCoordinateUpdate.fileName, pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackURL);
                          } else if (lastTrackURL) {
                            window.location.href = lastTrackURL;
                          } else {
                            updateMarkers();
                          }
                        }, 700);
                      }
                    }
                  } catch(e) {
                    console.error('Progress parse error:', e);
                  }
                };
                eventSource.onerror = () => {
                  if (eventSource) eventSource.close();
                  serverProcessing.innerText = '✘ Connection lost';
                  serverProcessing.style.color = 'red';
                };
              } else if (response.status === 'success') {
                // Legacy sync response (shouldn't happen now, but keep for compatibility)
                lastTrackURL = response.trackURL;
                progressBarInner.classList.remove('processing');
                serverProcessing.innerText = translate('processing_on_server') + ' 100%';
                serverProcessing.style.color = '#4caf50';

                if (response.needsCoordinates && response.trackID) {
                  serverProcessing.innerText = '⚠ Needs location';
                  serverProcessing.style.color = 'orange';
                  pendingCoordinateUpdate = { trackID: response.trackID, fileName: file.name, trackURL: response.trackURL };
                }
                
                completedUploads++;
                if (completedUploads === totalFiles) {
                  setTimeout(() => {
                    fileOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                    if (pendingCoordinateUpdate) {
                      showCoordinateDialog(pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackID, pendingCoordinateUpdate.fileName, pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackURL);
                    } else if (lastTrackURL) {
                      window.location.href = lastTrackURL;
                    } else {
                      updateMarkers();
                    }
                  }, 700);
                }
              } else {
                serverProcessing.innerText = translate('error_processing_files');
                serverProcessing.style.color = 'red';
              }
            } else {
              // Check if authentication is required
              if (xhr.status === 401 || xhr.status === 403) {
                serverProcessing.innerHTML = '🔒 Please <a href="/login" style="color: #2196F3; text-decoration: underline;">log in</a> or <a href="/register" style="color: #2196F3; text-decoration: underline;">register</a> to upload files';
                serverProcessing.style.color = '#ff9800';
                serverProcessing.style.fontSize = '16px';
                serverProcessing.style.fontWeight = 'bold';
                serverProcessing.style.padding = '10px';
                serverProcessing.style.marginTop = '10px';
              } else {
                serverProcessing.innerText = translate('error_during_upload');
                serverProcessing.style.color = 'red';
              }
            }
          };

          /* send file */
            const formData = new FormData();
          formData.append('files[]', file);
          xhr.send(formData);
        });
      }

    <!-- Coordinate Input Dialog Script -->
    <script>
      let pendingCoordinateUpdate = null;
      let isPickingLocation = false;
      let pickLocationHandler = null;

      function showCoordinateDialog(trackID, fileName, trackURL) {
        pendingCoordinateUpdate = { trackID, fileName, trackURL };
        const dialog = document.getElementById('coordinateInputDialog');
        const statusEl = document.getElementById('coordInputStatus');
        const errorEl = document.getElementById('coordInputError');

        statusEl.textContent = `File: ${fileName}`;
        statusEl.style.display = 'block';
        errorEl.style.display = 'none';

        dialog.style.display = 'flex';

        // Pre-fill with current map center if available
        if (map) {
          const center = map.getCenter();
          document.getElementById('coordInputLat').value = center.lat.toFixed(6);
          document.getElementById('coordInputLon').value = center.lng.toFixed(6);
        }
      }

      function hideCoordinateDialog() {
        document.getElementById('coordinateInputDialog').style.display = 'none';
        pendingCoordinateUpdate = null;
        // Clean up picking mode if active
        if (isPickingLocation && pickLocationHandler) {
          map.off('click', pickLocationHandler);
        }
        isPickingLocation = false;
        pickLocationHandler = null;
      }

      async function submitCoordinates() {
        const latInput = document.getElementById('coordInputLat');
        const lonInput = document.getElementById('coordInputLon');
        const errorEl = document.getElementById('coordInputError');
        const submitBtn = document.getElementById('coordSubmitBtn');

        const lat = parseFloat(latInput.value);
        const lon = parseFloat(lonInput.value);

        // Validate inputs
        if (isNaN(lat) || isNaN(lon)) {
          errorEl.textContent = 'Please enter valid numbers for latitude and longitude.';
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          return;
        }

        if (lat < -90 || lat > 90) {
          errorEl.textContent = 'Latitude must be between -90 and 90.';
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          return;
        }

        if (lon < -180 || lon > 180) {
          errorEl.textContent = 'Longitude must be between -180 and 180.';
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          return;
        }

        if (!pendingCoordinateUpdate) {
          errorEl.textContent = 'No pending upload to update.';
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          return;
        }

        // Disable submit button during request
        submitBtn.disabled = true;
        submitBtn.textContent = 'Updating...';
        errorEl.style.display = 'none';

        try {
          const response = await fetch('/api/update-coordinates', {
            method: 'POST',
            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              trackID: pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackID,
              lat: lat,
              lon: lon
            })
          });

          const result = await response.json();

          if (response.ok && result.status === 'success') {
            // Success! Navigate to the track page
            const trackURL = pendingCoordinateUpdate ? pendingCoordinateUpdate.trackURL : null;
            hideCoordinateDialog();
            if (trackURL) {
              window.location.href = trackURL;
            } else {
              // Fallback to map location if trackURL is not available
              const zoom = 15;
              window.location.href = `/#${zoom}/${lat}/${lon}`;
            }
          } else {
            errorEl.textContent = result.error || 'Failed to update coordinates. Please try again.';
            errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          }
        } catch (error) {
          errorEl.textContent = 'Network error. Please check your connection and try again.';
          errorEl.style.display = 'block';
        } finally {
          submitBtn.disabled = false;
          submitBtn.textContent = 'Submit Location';
        }
      }

      // Event listeners for coordinate dialog
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
        // Submit button
        document.getElementById('coordSubmitBtn').addEventListener('click', submitCoordinates);

        // Cancel button
        document.getElementById('coordCancelBtn').addEventListener('click', hideCoordinateDialog);

        // Click on map button
        document.getElementById('coordMapPickBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
          const statusEl = document.getElementById('coordInputStatus');
          statusEl.textContent = 'Click anywhere on the map to select a location...';

          // Store current pending update before hiding dialog
          const currentUpdate = pendingCoordinateUpdate;
          hideCoordinateDialog();

          // Set picking mode flag so marker clicks are intercepted
          isPickingLocation = true;

          // Add one-time click handler to map
          const mapClickHandler = function(e) {
            document.getElementById('coordInputLat').value = e.latlng.lat.toFixed(6);
            document.getElementById('coordInputLon').value = e.latlng.lng.toFixed(6);
            isPickingLocation = false;
            pickLocationHandler = null;
            showCoordinateDialog(currentUpdate.trackID, currentUpdate.fileName, currentUpdate.trackURL);
            map.off('click', mapClickHandler);
          };

          pickLocationHandler = mapClickHandler;
          map.once('click', mapClickHandler);
        });

        // Use current location button
        document.getElementById('coordCurrentBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
          const errorEl = document.getElementById('coordInputError');

          if ('geolocation' in navigator) {
            errorEl.textContent = 'Getting your location...';
            errorEl.style.color = 'var(--isotope-highlight)';
            errorEl.style.display = 'block';

            navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
              function(position) {
                document.getElementById('coordInputLat').value = position.coords.latitude.toFixed(6);
                document.getElementById('coordInputLon').value = position.coords.longitude.toFixed(6);
                errorEl.style.display = 'none';
              },
              function(error) {
                errorEl.textContent = 'Could not get your location: ' + error.message;
                errorEl.style.color = '#f44336';
              }
            );
          } else {
            errorEl.textContent = 'Geolocation is not supported by your browser.';
            errorEl.style.color = '#f44336';
            errorEl.style.display = 'block';
          }
        });

        // Close dialog on Escape key
        document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
          if (e.key === 'Escape' && document.getElementById('coordinateInputDialog').style.display === 'flex') {
            hideCoordinateDialog();
          }
        });
      });
    </script>

    <!-- Theme toggle script -->
    <script>
      // Synchronize UI theme with map tiles and remember the choice for the session.
      document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        var sw = document.getElementById('themeSwitch');
        if (!sw) return;
        var media = window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)');

        function applyTheme(theme) {
          document.documentElement.dataset.theme = theme; // switch CSS variables
          if (window.osmLayer) {
            window.osmLayer.setUrl(theme === 'dark' ? window.osmDark : window.osmLight);
          }
          sw.checked = theme === 'dark';
        }

        var storedTheme = sessionStorage.getItem('themePreference');
        var initialTheme = storedTheme ? storedTheme : (media.matches ? 'dark' : 'light');
        applyTheme(initialTheme); // set initial state

        sw.addEventListener('change', function () {
          var newTheme = this.checked ? 'dark' : 'light';
          applyTheme(newTheme);
          sessionStorage.setItem('themePreference', newTheme);
        });

        var toggleBox = document.getElementById('themeToggle');
        if (toggleBox) {
          toggleBox.addEventListener('keydown', function (ev) {
            if (ev.key === 'Enter' || ev.key === ' ') {
              ev.preventDefault();
              sw.checked = !sw.checked;
              sw.dispatchEvent(new Event('change'));
            }
          });
        }

        media.addEventListener('change', function (e) {
          var newTheme = e.matches ? 'dark' : 'light';
          applyTheme(newTheme);
          sessionStorage.setItem('themePreference', newTheme);
        });
      });
    </script>


<!--

    • Show modal; close on backdrop click for convenience.

<script>
  // Build legend HTML with color squares for tooltip and modal.
  function buildLegendHTML(lang) {
    if (currentColoring === 'safecast') {
      var desc = translate('legend_safecast_desc');
      if (desc === 'legend_safecast_desc') {
        desc = "This is the traditional radiation level color scale adopted by Safecast in 2013 and used consistently on our maps since then. Users have found it intuitive to understand, as lower radiation levels are depicted as \"cool\", and higher levels as \"warm.\" The wide color range allows subtle differences to be distinguished instantly at a glance, and it is logarithmic, allowing users to easily see the relatively smaller differences in radiation levels close natural background, while allowing levels several orders of magnitude higher to be displayed as well.";
      }
      return '<p>' + desc + '</p>';
    }

    // Chicha 4-bin logic
    var key = 'legend_full_' + lang;
    var txt = translate(key);
    var parts = txt.split('\n\n');
    function stripBullet(line) {
      return line.replace(/^■\s*/, '');
    }
    function square(color) {
      return '<span class="legend-square" style="background:' + color + ';"></span>';
    }
    return parts.map(function(p){
      var lines = p.split('\n').map(function(line){
        // These thresholds are matched by text in translations
        if (line.includes('0–11')) return square('#008000') + stripBullet(line);
        if (line.includes('11–30')) return square('#FFD700') + stripBullet(line);
        if (line.includes('30–100')) return square('#FF4500') + stripBullet(line);
        if (line.includes('>100')) return square('#000000') + stripBullet(line);
        return line;
      }).join('<br>');
      return '<p style="margin:0 0 1em 0;">' + lines + '</p>';
    }).join('');
  }

  // Display the full legend text in current language.
  // Exposed so marker popups reuse the same modal.
  function openLegendModal() {
    if (window.__hideLegendHint) {
      window.__hideLegendHint();
    }
    var lang = (typeof currentLang !== 'undefined') ? currentLang : 'en';
    var html = buildLegendHTML(lang);
    var box = document.getElementById('legendText');
    if (box) box.innerHTML = html;
    var modal = document.getElementById('legendModal');
    if (modal) modal.style.display = 'flex';
  }

  // Build HTML for info modal from translation text
  function buildInfoHTML(txt) {
    return txt.split('\n\n').map(function(p){
      return '<p style="margin:0 0 1em 0;">' + p.split('\n').join('<br>') + '</p>';
    }).join('');
  }

  // Turn license mentions into modal triggers so readers stay on the map page.
  function decorateLicenseLinks(txt) {
    if (typeof txt !== 'string' || !txt) {
      return txt;
    }
    var withMitAnchor = txt.replace(/<a[^>]*href=\u0022\/LICENSE\u0022[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/gi, function(_, label) {
      return '<a href="#" class="license-link" data-license="mit">' + label + '</a>';
    });
    var withCc0Anchor = withMitAnchor.replace(/Creative Commons 1\.0(\s*\(CC0\))?/gi, function(match) {
      return '<a href="#" class="license-link" data-license="cc0">' + match + '</a>';
    });
    return withCc0Anchor;
  }

  // Open a specific license modal based on the identifier requested by the user.
  // We fetch the source file lazily so embedded binaries stay in sync with
  // the repository licenses even when served offline.
  function openLicenseModal(code) {
    if (!code) return;
    var selector = '.license-modal[data-license="' + code + '"]';
    var modal = document.querySelector(selector);
    if (!modal) return;

    var body = modal.querySelector('[data-license-url]');
    if (body) {
      var loadedState = body.getAttribute('data-license-loaded');
      var loadingState = body.getAttribute('data-license-loading');
      if (loadedState !== 'true' && loadingState !== 'true') {
        var url = body.getAttribute('data-license-url');
        if (url) {
          body.textContent = 'Loading…';
          body.setAttribute('data-license-loading', 'true');

          var handleSuccess = function(text) {
            body.textContent = text;
            body.setAttribute('data-license-loaded', 'true');
            body.setAttribute('data-license-loading', 'false');
          };

          var handleError = function(err) {
            if (window.console && console.error) {
              console.error('Failed to load license text for', code, err);
            }
            body.textContent = 'Unable to load the license text. Please download it from the repository.';
            body.setAttribute('data-license-loaded', 'error');
            body.setAttribute('data-license-loading', 'false');
          };

          if (window.fetch) {
            fetch(url, { cache: 'no-store' })
              .then(function(resp) {
                if (!resp.ok) {
                  throw new Error('HTTP ' + resp.status);
                }
                return resp.text();
              })
              .then(handleSuccess)
              .catch(handleError);
          } else {
            var xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
            xhr.open('GET', url, true);
            xhr.onreadystatechange = function() {
              if (xhr.readyState === 4) {
                if (xhr.status >= 200 && xhr.status < 300) {
                  handleSuccess(xhr.responseText);
                } else {
                  handleError(new Error('HTTP ' + xhr.status));
                }
              }
            };
            xhr.onerror = function() { handleError(new Error('network error')); };
            xhr.send();
          }
        }
      }
    }

    modal.style.display = 'flex';
  }

  // Close the provided license modal so the overlay disappears cleanly.
  function closeLicenseModal(modal) {
    if (modal) {
      modal.style.display = 'none';
    }
  }

  // Example definitions stay in code so translations only supply human text.
  const apiExamples = [
    { key: 'root', method: 'api_method_get', methodFallback: 'GET', path: '/api', url: '/api' },

Perfect! Comprehensive login logging has been implemented successfully. Here's what's now being logged:

## Login Logging Summary

### ✅ **Successful Login Events**
Logs include:
- User ID and email
- Authentication method (password or API key)
- IP address
- User agent (browser/client info)
- Timestamp (automatic with log package)

Example log:
```
AUTH: Successful login - user_id=42 email=user@example.com method=password ip=192.168.1.100 user_agent=Mozilla/5.0...
```

### ✅ **Failed Login Attempts**
Detailed logging for various failure scenarios:

1. **Invalid API Key:**
   ```
   AUTH: Failed login attempt - email=user@example.com method=api_key reason=invalid_key ip=192.168.1.100
   ```

2. **Email/API Key Mismatch:**
   ```
   AUTH: Failed login attempt - email=wrong@example.com method=api_key reason=email_mismatch ip=192.168.1.100
   ```

3. **User Not Found (Password auth):**
   ```
   AUTH: Failed login attempt - email=unknown@example.com method=password reason=user_not_found ip=192.168.1.100
   ```

4. **Invalid Password:**
   ```
   AUTH: Failed login attempt - email=user@example.com method=password reason=invalid_password ip=192.168.1.100
   ```

5. **No Credentials Provided:**
   ```
   AUTH: Failed login attempt - email=user@example.com method=none reason=no_credentials ip=192.168.1.100
   ```

6. **Account Disabled:**
   ```
   AUTH: Failed login attempt - email=user@example.com user_id=42 method=password reason=account_disabled ip=192.168.1.100
   ```

### ✅ **Additional Security Events**

1. **User Registration:**
   ```
   AUTH: New user registered - user_id=42 email=user@example.com username=john_doe ip=192.168.1.100
   ```

2. **User Logout:**
   ```
   AUTH: User logout - user_id=42 email=user@example.com ip=192.168.1.100
   ```

3. **Email Verification:**
   ```
   AUTH: Email verified - user_id=42 email=user@example.com ip=192.168.1.100
   ```

4. **Password Changed:**
   ```
   AUTH: Password changed - user_id=42 email=user@example.com ip=192.168.1.100
   ```

## Security Benefits

This logging enables you to:

✅ **Detect brute force attacks** - Multiple failed attempts from same IP
✅ **Monitor account compromises** - Unusual login patterns or IPs
✅ **Track API key vs password usage** - Understand how users authenticate
✅ **Audit trail** - Complete history of authentication events
✅ **Debug issues** - Detailed failure reasons help troubleshoot problems
✅ **Compliance** - Meet security audit requirements

## Log Format

All logs use the prefix `AUTH:` for easy filtering:
```bash
# View all auth events
grep "AUTH:" /path/to/logfile

# View only failed logins
grep "AUTH: Failed login" /path/to/logfile

# View logins from specific IP
grep "AUTH:.*ip=192.168.1.100" /path/to/logfile

# Count failed password attempts
grep "AUTH: Failed login.*method=password" /path/to/logfile | wc -l
```

The logging is production-ready and does not log sensitive information (passwords or API keys are never logged)!
